question: On six declared places, what structure do two declared pairings generate, what does the classical inner-four reading do to the sixty-four binary states as an iterated finite exploration, how do the sixty-four binary states and the seven hundred twenty-nine ternary addresses read each other, and is the classical four-outcome distribution of the yarrow procedure a theorem of its arithmetic or a statement about a declared policy of dividing the pile?
level: External exact combinatorics and exact rational arithmetic; every statement decided by exhaustion over a declared finite set; imported set-theoretic semantics for the syllogism family named but not reproved; no native semantic construction
domain: The six places 1..6 with two declared involutive matchings; the sixty-four words of F2^6 with the complement, reversal and inner-four maps; the seven hundred twenty-nine six-place ternary addresses with a head of four places and a position of two; the four-outcome strip arithmetic of a declared three-step partition procedure; the sixty-four moods, four figures and two declared existence scopes of a monadic syllogism family

objects.reversal: order reversal of the six places

quantifiers: All sixty-four binary states for every map, orbit, fixed set, kernel, image and hitting time
All ordered pairs of the sixty-four states for F2-linearity and all 64 x 64 pairs for isometry
All six unit places for the single-place change relation and its image
All seven hundred twenty-nine ternary addresses, their eight intra-head successor steps and the one hundred sixty-two carries
All seven hundred twenty-nine numeral successors compared against the declared successor relation
All forty-eight admissible splits of the first pile and all splits of every pile reachable at the second and third steps
All five hundred twelve syllogism contracts against all two hundred fifty-five non-empty occupancy masks
grammar: finite permutations and their generated group by closure
exact integer linear algebra over F2 by exhaustion
exact orbit partitions and Burnside counts by exhaustion
base-three digit arithmetic on six places
exact rational arithmetic over Fraction for the split distribution
acceptance: The two declared matchings are transversal, their union is a single six-cycle, the group they generate has order six and acts freely and transitively on the six places, and that six-cycle is NOT an element of the group
The inner-four reading is F2-linear of rank four with kernel spanned by the first and last places, so exactly those two places are invisible to it
The inner-four reading commutes with complement and with reversal, and carries a single-place change to the image of that place

The second iterate of the inner-four reading depends only on the third and fourth places; the fourth equals the second; the eventual image has exactly four elements; the periodic set equals the eventual image; the fixed states are the two constant states; every state reaches the eventual image within two steps
On the eventual image the clock generated by the two pairings and the inner-four reading act identically

Complement is a fixed-point-free involution on the sixty-four states; reversal has exactly eight fixed states and thirty-six orbits; the group they generate has twenty orbits, twelve of size four and eight of size two
The states fixed by the whole declared group are exactly the two constant states, which is also the fixed set of the inner-four reading

The ternary interface has four head places and two position places, exactly seven hundred twenty-nine addresses in bijection with the head-and-position pairs, six hundred forty-eight declared successor steps of which four hundred eighty-six change one ternary digit and one hundred sixty-two change two, and eighty-one declared states with no successor
The declared successor agrees with the numeral successor on every declared step and differs from it exactly on the eighty-one states where the numeral would carry into a head place

The binary single-change relation is total and six-regular, with three hundred eighty-four directed steps each changing exactly one place, while the ternary declared successor changes two places in one hundred sixty-two of six hundred forty-eight steps

The binary words embed isometrically onto the zero-one subcube of the ternary addresses, and no placewise binary reading of the ternary addresses is injective: the smallest achievable largest fibre is sixty-four against the twelve that counting alone permits
The two interface sizes are coprime and their joint period is six to the sixth
Under the remainder convention that makes the first strip close onto five and nine, the first strip is five with probability exactly three quarters, which is the classical value
At every pile reachable at the second and third steps the uniform-split probability of a strip of four is strictly greater than one half, so the classical one half is never attained

The uniform-split, independent-stalk and residue-class policies give three different exact outcome distributions, and only the residue-class policy reproduces three sixteenths, seven sixteenths, five sixteenths and one sixteenth
The same syllogism syntax decides fifteen forms under the boolean scope and twenty-four under the non-empty-terms scope, each countermodel exhibited as an occupancy mask
protected: No claim that any classical text, name, edition, sequence or commentary is represented here; no such material is imported and no identification of a state with a classical hexagram, head or praise is made
No claim that the places of the two interfaces are the same objects, that their digits are truth values, or that the third ternary digit value is an unknown
No claim that the six places are six Adva primitive words, or that any orbit, kernel or periodic set carries a native semantic identity
No claim about the historical yarrow procedure, its textual form, its divinatory use, or the provenance of the classical ratios
No claim that the syllogism family covers Aristotelian logic beyond the declared monadic fragment and the two declared existence scopes
No floating-point value enters any acceptance test
No native Rust witness, no claim promotion beyond bounded-external-experiment, no Seal, no library admission
residual: What is established is a set of exact statements about declared finite objects: a group of order six on six places, a rank-four linear reading whose second iterate forgets four of the six places and whose eventual behaviour is either one of two rest states or one two-cycle, two interfaces of sixty-four and seven hundred twenty-nine states that read each other only one way, and a three-step partition arithmetic whose classical four-outcome table is reproduced by one declared policy and by none of the other two. Nothing here identifies these objects with any text: the classical names that appear to fit the four states at the centre of the inner-four reading, the eight reversal-fixed states and the eighteen pairing orbits are left unattached, because attaching them needs a sourced review this note does not perform and no text may be imported. The arithmetic result is a statement about the declared policies, not about any historical procedure: which policy a historical practice used is not decided, the endpoint conventions are separated only for the first step, and the pile sizes reachable at the second step are not the sizes the procedure was described with. The two interfaces are compared through one declared place-to-place correspondence; a different correspondence changes the embedding but not the counting bounds. Every syllogism statement is about the declared monadic fragment and its two scopes, not about any logic.
